ADU Local Track Trees

Phase B of the setback engine: the detached, new-construction ADU that leaves the state track because it is over 800 sf (or taller than 16 ft, 18 ft near transit). Every jurisdiction walks the same seven gates; what differs is which gates are live, which need a new input, and where the local text has to be clamped to state law. Values come from the 2026-10-07 survey of all 28 ADU chapters, cited but not yet verified as engine data.

Which gates are live, per jurisdiction

Click a row to draw that jurisdiction's tree. "Live gates" counts the gates that are more than a fixed number: a new input, a height-conditioned branch, a clamp, an ambiguity or a corpus gap.
